name: tapdeck
description: Real-time tab audio processing Chrome extension. (This package.json exists only for dev tooling - tests and syntax checks; it is not part of the loaded extension.)

scripts.pack: node tools/check.js && rm -f tapdeck-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r -X tapdeck-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json background.js offscreen.html offscreen.js popup.html popup.js editor.html editor.css editor.js editor-helpers.js editor-renderers.js module-registry.js dsp-math.js worklet icons fonts
